```{r}
# importing libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(viridis)

```

```{r}
shp <- st_read("data/processed_grid.shp")
names(shp)
```

```{r}
# make maps!
n_fires_plt <- shp %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=n_fires)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.01) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno") +
    theme_void()

shp %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=n_fires, alpha=is_ndgn)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.01) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno") +
    scale_alpha_binned(range=c(0.6, 1)) +
    theme_void()

max_acres_plt <- shp %>%
    mutate(max_crs = as.numeric(max_crs)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, fill=max_crs)) +
    geom_sf(linewidth=0.01) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option="inferno") +
    theme_void()

max_acres_plt

shp %>%
    ggplot(aes(geometry=geometry, alpha=totl_sm, ))
```


```{r}
grid <- read_csv("data/processed_grid.csv")
grid %>%
    summarize(
        plant_sum = sum(plant_sum),
        total_sum = sum(total_sum, n_xerophyllum, n_rubus)
    )

names(grid)
```
